name: gemini-web
description: Gemini-powered tools: web search, URL summarization, and Nano Banana image generation

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Optional. AI Studio key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. When set, the plugin uses the Gemini API path with this key and ignores any GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI / GOOGLE_API_KEY env vars. Leave blank to fall back to standard env-var auth.

search_model.title: Search / summarization model
search_model.description: Optional. Model ID for web_search and summarize_pages. Must support both google_search grounding and the url_context tool. Leave blank for the default (gemini-flash-latest).

image_model.title: Image generation model
image_model.description: Optional. Model ID for generate_image. Leave blank for the default (gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview, a.k.a. Nano Banana 2).

interface.shortDescription: Search, summarize URLs, and generate images with Gemini.
interface.longDescription: Gemini-powered MCP tools for real Google Search, multi-page URL summaries, and Nano Banana image generation. Configure GOOGLE_API_KEY for Gemini API auth or Vertex AI environment variables for enterprise auth.
defaultPrompt: Use Gemini to search the web for current sources.
Generate an image with Nano Banana.
